about_short_description.short_description: Orthogonal is advancing the field of display manufacturing by lifting the constraints of traditional photolithography.

product.name: OSCoR Photoresist System
product.description: A photoresist system compatible with organic materials enabling high-resolution patterning for OLED and organic electronic manufacturing.

product.name: High Resolution OLED (VR) Manufacturing Solution
product.description: A manufacturing approach using photolithography to produce ultra-high resolution OLED displays for virtual reality applications, surpassing traditional fine metal mask methods.

product.name: Mobile OLED Manufacturing Solution
product.description: A photolithography-based manufacturing process for mobile OLED displays that improves yield, throughput, and scalability compared to fine metal mask methods.

product.name: Organic Photodetector Patterning for Under-Display Fingerprint Sensors
product.description: A photolithographic patterning technology for organic photodetectors used in under-display fingerprint sensors with high resolution and sensitivity.

product.name: ODE (Orthogonal Design Engineering)
product.description: An AI-native cloud platform for end-to-end hardware design, simulation, and manufacturing using natural language prompts.
